verdict.rationale: Dynadot's API document page has per-command examples and a dedicated API Sandbox on its own host, so a user can run those examples against a safe, pre-funded test account. There is no evidence of an interactive in-browser 'try it' explorer, and OpenAPI/Swagger specs that would power one all return 404. Missing for 10: interactive in-page API explorer, evidence that examples are executable directly from the reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Dynadot API Sandbox environment allows you to safely test your API integrations without affecting your live account or real funds
The sandbox also covers the legacy v3 API with parallel per-command examples.
